Program Rules

Testing is only authorized on the targets listed as In-Scope. Any domain/property of MathWorks not listed explicitly in the targets section is out of scope.

Engagement Guidelines

  • Persistent testing on any publicly facing functionality is not permitted. Any created content must be deleted within FIVE minutes.

Out of Scope

The following finding types are specifically excluded from the bounty:

  • Denial of Service attacks of any type.
  • Social engineering/phishing attacks
  • Self XSS
